name: White Angel
source:
Hero lives along in the house. One day he goes from school with childhood friend Ichigo when  his cousin Aya and maid Karen suddenly push into living with him. And feeling the warmth of relations he starts to recover memories sealed in the past...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-january-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公独自住在家中。某天，他和青梅竹马放学回家时，堂妹与女仆突然搬来同住。在亲情的温暖中，他开始找回被封存于过去的记忆……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-january-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
